title: How an agent decides it is done

items.stem: A harness exits its loop as soon as the reply text contains the word "done". The model replies: "Done reading the file, now fixing the typo", and the reply includes an edit_file tool call. What happens?

options.text: The loop raises an error for mixed text and tool call
The loop ignores the word and runs until max_turns
The loop exits early and the edit never gets run
The loop runs the edit and then exits on the next

items.stem: In the Agent SDK, a task needs 6 turns that each contain tool calls, and then one final text-only reply. Each tool-call turn and the final text-only reply count toward max_turns. What is the smallest max_turns that lets the run finish with subtype success?
A result message has subtype error_max_budget_usd. Which field, present on a success result, is missing from it?
A Messages API call returns stop_reason max_tokens, and the reply ends in the middle of a sentence. What should the loop conclude?

options.text: Done: return the reply as the finished answer
Cut off: raise max_tokens or ask it to continue
Refused: retry the same request on another model
Tool call: run the tool and send back the result
